description: Share of a token's LP tokens that are burned (dead or zero address) or locked, from GoPlus lp_holders on Ethereum, BSC, Base, Arbitrum or Polygon. Lists the top 10 LP holders with GoPlus's lock flag and tag (a locker's name only when GoPlus gives it). Does not query Uncx, Team.Finance or Streamflow directly. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: ethereum, bsc, base, arbitrum or polygon (default ethereum)
